open_points.subject: context — A18 / INV-027 derivation ownership
open_points.text: A18 | `budget_management` | `snapshot_import`, `derived_views`, `budget_repository`, `snapshot_import_repository`, `project_section_repository`; `budget_management` Must not own "derived totals"; `derived_views` Owns "A21 (derivation)"; INV-027: "budget totals and all financial aggregates are derived at read time"
open_points.question: Which decision and module own INV-027's recomputation rule, including recomputation after budget-version activation?
options: Move INV-027's derivation rule to A21 with `derived_views` as owner, while A18 retains activation and persistence invariants
Keep INV-027 in A18 but explicitly assign that part to consumer `derived_views`
Make `budget_management` own derivation or invalidation despite its prohibition on owning derived totals
open_points.default_guess: Move the derivation rule to A21 and `derived_views`; keep activation under A18 and `budget_management`.

open_points.subject: context — A28 operation-time rules
open_points.text: A28 | `system_clock` | every module that reads the time; "The primary owner owns every other rule of the decision"; `system_clock` Must not own "When an operation reads the time, how many readings it takes, which instant it reuses, any comparison, TTL arithmetic, storage or ordering of a reading, and the rate-limit window"; "each consumer applies the one-instant rule to its own timestamps"
open_points.question: Who owns A28's per-operation one-reading, instant-reuse, comparison, TTL, supplied-time normalization and elapsed-window rules, since the primary owner is forbidden to own them and the consumer modules do not name their respective A28 parts in their Owns sections?
options: Split A28: `system_clock` owns only the host-clock backend, while each use-case module, `transport_guard`, and `audit_writer` explicitly owns its operation-specific timing rules
Keep `system_clock` as primary owner and expand it to orchestrate operation-scoped time use
Record the operation rules as cross-cutting and list each applying module explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Split A28 and explicitly assign each operation rule to its applying module; retain `system_clock` as owner only of clock access and representation.
